offering_description.value: Manufactures railcars and leases and maintains railcar fleets for railroads, shippers and lessors. Also makes highway guardrail and crash-protection products sold to transportation agencies and contractors.

primary_products.value: railcars; highway guardrail; crash cushions; railcar parts

primary_services.value: railcar leasing and fleet management; railcar maintenance and repair; railcar refurbishment

customer_segment.value: B2B: railroads, railcar shippers, railcar lessors, industrial and energy companies; B2G: state and federal transportation departments and highway agencies

end_markets.value: rail transportation; energy and chemicals; agriculture; highway infrastructure

revenue_model.value: product sales: railcars and highway safety products sold to customers; rental or leasing: railcars leased to shippers and railroads; service fees: railcar maintenance, repair and refurbishment
revenue_model.category: product sales; rental or leasing; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds railcars and highway safety products from steel and components, sold to railroads and agencies; asset operator: owns and leases railcar fleet to shippers and railroads; service provider: maintains and refurbishes railcars for fleet owners
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; asset operator; service provider

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: diversified: railcar manufacturing and leasing, highway safety products for transportation agencies

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: railcars sold directly to railroads, shippers and lessors; distributors / dealers: highway safety products sold through distributors to contractors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: railcar safety standards from the Federal Railroad Administration and AAR, highway products must meet federal crash-testing standards
